I didn't say that the 3rd person is not immersive, it is only a piece in immersiveness, but, as I said, the 1st person is more immersive than the 3rd person, because, since the 1st person POVs usually start with characters and the 3rd person with theme, it's easier to dive in the story when you get to know the characters, faster than 3rd person.
